findings: It is used when the material is connected to a respected person. The general 謙譲語I rule concerns the person toward whom the action is directed, but the exact object relations in this article are not established.
Documents, emails, works, photos, and websites can all be read/reviewed/consulted with 拝見する. The source does not give these object-specific senses or example sentences.

Professional communications commonly use the stated forms, while the agent is usually the speaker or group. The source supports speaker-side 謙譲語I and says 拝見 is generally used as a verb; it does not measure professional frequency.
